mapper.insert: INSERT INTO group_agent_plan (group_conversation_id, message_id, ai_conversation_id, asker_id, plan_json, plan_version, created_at) VALUES (#{groupConversationId}, #{messageId}, #{aiConversationId}, #{askerId}, #{planJson}, #{planVersion}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, group_conversation_id AS groupConversationId, message_id AS messageId, ai_conversation_id AS aiConversationId, asker_id AS askerId, plan_json AS planJson, plan_version AS planVersion, created_at AS createdAt FROM group_agent_plan WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, group_conversation_id AS groupConversationId, message_id AS messageId, ai_conversation_id AS aiConversationId, asker_id AS askerId, plan_json AS planJson, plan_version AS planVersion, created_at AS createdAt FROM group_agent_plan WHERE message_id = #{messageId} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, group_conversation_id AS groupConversationId, message_id AS messageId, ai_conversation_id AS aiConversationId, asker_id AS askerId, plan_json AS planJson, plan_version AS planVersion, created_at AS createdAt FROM group_agent_plan WHERE group_conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
